composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Idempotent create: if this request carries an 'Idempotency-Key' already seen from a prior
# successful create, replay the originally created owner (200) instead of creating a duplicate.
# Runs first, before any validation or duplicate check, and publishes the key for recordIdempotency.
checkIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotencyKey
  next: validate

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  next: validatePostcode

# Validate the postcode WHEN PRESENT (optional when absent), so an out-of-range postcode
# for the city's region is a 400 before the owner is built.
validatePostcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerPostcode
  next: validateRegistrationDate

# Reject a SUPPLIED registrationDate later than the server date as a 400, before the date is
# resolved/defaulted. A request that omits the date stays accepted.
validateRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateRegistrationDate
  next: normalizeTelephone

normalizeTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
  next: normalizeEmail

normalizeEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerEmail
  next: rejectDisposableEmail

# Reject a supplied email whose domain is on the disposable-domain blocklist as a 400. Runs after
# normalizeEmail so the domain is already syntactically valid and lower-cased.
rejectDisposableEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectDisposableEmailDomain
  next: resolveRegistrationDate

# Resolve the effective registration date (supplied-or-default, rolled forward off weekends)
# before the daily limit, so the limit counts owners per the same adjusted business day.
resolveRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ResolveRegistrationDate
  next: ensureCityCapacity

ensureCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureDailyLimit

ensureDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureDailyLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureUniqueIdentity

# Consolidated duplicate detection: reject 409 only when the new owner's WHOLE derived identityKey
# (SHA-256 hex over normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)) equals an existing owner's.
# The identityKey is the single identity rule; the computed householdId no longer contributes.
ensureUniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: flagPossibleDuplicate

# Soft duplicate: not a hard identity collision (already rejected above), but its identityKey differs
# while soundex(lastName) and postcode both match an existing owner. Still created; flagged with
# possibleDuplicate/possibleDuplicateOf so the response can surface the likely match.
flagPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.FlagPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdSize

assignHouseholdSize:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdSize
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: defaultRegistrationDate

defaultRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.DefaultOwnerRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMemberId

assignMemberId:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMemberId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignBulkSignupWarning

assignBulkSignupWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCapacityWarning

# Flag capacityWarning when the owner's city already held 40-49 owners (approaching the hard limit
# of 50). Runs before save, so the owner being created is not yet persisted and never counts itself.
assignCapacityWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCapacityWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: capMembershipLevel

# Capture the household-capped membershipLevel: the naturally computed level, but no more than one
# above the current maximum among existing household members. Runs after householdSize/namesakeCount
# are set (the level's inputs) and before save, so the capped value is persisted.
capMembershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CapMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

# Emit an AUDIT line for the created owner (id assigned by save) before responding.
audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: notifyWelcome

# Enqueue a welcome notification: emit a NOTIFY line carrying the owner id (assigned by
# save) and the memberId, on successful create.
notifyWelcome:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NotifyWelcome
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: recordIdempotency

# Remember this request's Idempotency-Key -> new owner id (when a key was supplied) so a later
# repeat with the same key replays this owner instead of creating a duplicate.
recordIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotencyKey
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

# Owner Identity Feature — Investigation Report

All code lives under `/home/daniel/sandbox/`. The feature is the `POST /api/owners` create pipeline (wired in `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`) plus a set of derivation helpers in the `mapper` package, surfaced on read via MapStruct's `OwnerMapper`.

## Build system & running tests

- Build: Maven, `/home/daniel/sandbox/pom.xml`. Wrapper `/home/daniel/sandbox/mvnw`. Java/Spring Boot 4.x with OfficeFloor starter `officefloor-rest-spring-boot-4-starter` version `4.0.2` (property `officefloor.version`).
- Run all tests: `./mvnw test` (surefire). The acceptance tests are `@SpringBootTest @AutoConfigureMockMvc @Transactional`, so a single class: `./mvnw test -Dtest=AcceptanceTest`.
- Test/logging config: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/resources/application.properties`, `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/logback.xml`.

## 1. Derivation logic (householdId, identityKey, memberId, locality, timezone, region, segment)

### householdId — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignHousehold.java`
`class AssignHousehold { public void service(@Val Owner owner) }` and `static String householdId(String lastName, String postcode)`.
Logic: first **12 upper-case hex chars** of `SHA-256(normalize(lastName) + "|" + postcode.trim())`, where `normalize` = trim + collapse internal whitespace + lower-case. Returns `null` when postcode is null/blank. Deterministic per (lastName, postcode).

### identityKey — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/IdentityKey.java`
`public final class IdentityKey { public static String of(Owner owner) }`.
Logic: 64-char lower-case hex `SHA-256( normalizeTelephone(telephone) + "|" + lowerEmail + "|" + Soundex.of(lastName) )`. Telephone normalized to E.164 (falls back to raw string if invalid); email lower-cased or `""`; surname via Soundex. This is the single duplicate-detection key.
Note discrepancy: the OpenAPI description (line ~2159) says identityKey = `normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId` — the **doc text is stale**; the actual code uses `soundex(lastName)`, not `householdId`.

### memberId — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/MemberId.java` (helper) and `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignMemberId.java` (pipeline step)
Format `'<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'` (e.g. `NSW261A2B3C4D7`):
- `MemberId.of(region, fiscalYear, normalizedTelephone, lastName)` → `core = region + fiscalYear + hash8(...)`, then appends `CheckDigit.luhn(core)`.
- `MemberId.hash8` = first **8 upper-case hex chars** of `SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName)`.
- `MemberId.region(memberId)` strips an optional `-<n>` collision suffix, then takes the prefix before the fixed 11-char `<FY><HASH8><CHK>` suffix.
- `MemberId.locality(Owner)` = region from memberId, else falls back to `CityRegion.locality(postcode, city)`.
- `AssignMemberId.service` computes region via `CityRegion.locality(postcode, city)`, FY via `FiscalYear.yearSegment(registrationDate)`, and on collision with an existing owner's memberId appends `-<n>` (smallest n ≥ 2).

### locality / timezone / region / postcode ranges — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/CityRegion.java`

The response DTO is **generated from OpenAPI**: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`, schema `Owner` (starts line 2094) = `OwnerFields` + these derived read-only fields. components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "The honorific title of the pet owner. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS, DR. When supplied it prefixes the derived 'salutation'."
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' are supplied they are preferred and this field is returned as the composed, normalized address."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: "The first line of the owner's structured postal address. When supplied (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' input; normalized like 'address'."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: "The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. When present it is appended, after a single space, to the normalized 'addressLine1' to form the composed 'address'."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional; when supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares the same last name and postcode (the same household); such a request is created as a declared household member instead of being rejected as a duplicate. Optional; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: "The canonical URI of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>' using the owner's id."
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation formatted as '<title> <lastName>', or just the last name when no title was supplied."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: "The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678')."
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: "Assigned member ID formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': REGION is the canonical region derived from the postcode (postcode-preferred, city-table fallback); FY is the two-digit fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate; HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone + lastName; and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of <REGION><FY><HASH8>."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the year the fiscal year ends in. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a date from 1 July onward belongs to the fiscal year ending the following 30 June."
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic shared identifier for the owner's household, the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode. All owners of the same last name and postcode share this value automatically; null when the owner has no postcode.
              type: string
              example: '3F9A2C1D5E8B'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The derived duplicate-detection key, formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId. Two owners collide (409 on create) only when their whole identityKey is equal."
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3F9A2C1D5E8B'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Numeric membership points assigned on creation. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3 for a tenure over one elapsed fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level assigned on creation, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region, taken as the REGION part of the memberId ('<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'); this is the region derived from the postcode (postcode-preferred, city-table fallback: Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane); null when the region is not one of these."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's registration day before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: "True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the capacity limit of 50) before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: "True when, although not a hard duplicate, this owner shares an existing owner's last name and postcode with a different telephone; otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: "The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of, when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; otherwise null."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band derived from birthDate, computed as full years from birthDate to registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied."
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: "The owner's marketing segment '<TIER>_<AREA>': TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'; AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of PREMIUM_METRO, PREMIUM_REGIONAL, STANDARD_METRO, STANDARD_REGIONAL."
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: "True when the owner trips any signup-review heuristic: it is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate is set), its email domain is disposable-adjacent (a known throw-away mail provider under a different TLD, or a domain built from a disposable keyword), or its city is over its soft capacity (capacityWarning is set, i.e. 40 or more owners, approaching the hard cap of 50). Otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: "True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id}; the record is retained and still readable. False for a newly created owner."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "The honorific title of the pet owner. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS, DR. When supplied it prefixes the derived 'salutation'."
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' are supplied they are preferred and this field is returned as the composed, normalized address."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: "The first line of the owner's structured postal address. When supplied (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' input; normalized like 'address'."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: "The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. When present it is appended, after a single space, to the normalized 'addressLine1' to form the composed 'address'."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional; when supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares the same last name and postcode (the same household); such a request is created as a declared household member instead of being rejected as a duplicate. Optional; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false

    OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity

      type: object
      properties:

          readOnly: true

          type: string

          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: "A deterministic shared identifier for the owner's household: the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode + '|' + the 'V2' version tag. All owners of the same last name and postcode share this value automatically; null when the owner has no postcode."

          example: '3F9A2C1D5E8B'
          readOnly: true
      readOnly: true

            memberId:

              type: string

              type: string

              type: string

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "The honorific title of the pet owner. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS, DR. When supplied it prefixes the derived 'salutation'."
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' are supplied they are preferred and this field is returned as the composed, normalized address."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: "The first line of the owner's structured postal address. When supplied (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' input; normalized like 'address'."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: "The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. When present it is appended, after a single space, to the normalized 'addressLine1' to form the composed 'address'."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional; when supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares the same last name and postcode (the same household); such a request is created as a declared household member instead of being rejected as a duplicate. Optional; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: "The owner's version-2 identifiers, grouped together. The region code mixed into each carries a fixed 'V2' version tag, so no value matches its version-1 form; the plain region is exposed separately as the top-level 'locality'."
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: "Assigned member ID formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': REGION is the version-2 identity region (the canonical postcode-derived region with the 'V2' tag mixed in); FY is the two-digit fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate; HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone + lastName; and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of <REGION><FY><HASH8>."
          type: string
          example: 'NSWV2261A2B3C4D7'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: "The derived duplicate-detection key: the SHA-256 hex over normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + soundex(lastName) + '|' + the 'V2' version tag. Two owners collide (409 on create) only when their whole identityKey is equal."
          type: string
          example: 'a3f9c1d5e8b2470a1c3e5f7a9b0d2f4e6c8a0b2d4f6e8c0a2b4d6f8e0c2a4b6d'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: "A deterministic shared identifier for the owner's household: the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode + '|' + the 'V2' version tag. All owners of the same last name and postcode share this value automatically; null when the owner has no postcode."
          type: string
          example: '3F9A2C1D5E8B'
          readOnly: true
      readOnly: true
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: "The canonical URI of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>' using the owner's id."
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation formatted as '<title> <lastName>', or just the last name when no title was supplied."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: "The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678')."
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner identity contract this representation follows. Always 2.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: "The owner's version-2 identifiers (memberId, identityKey, householdId), grouped together and no longer at the top level."
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the year the fiscal year ends in. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a date from 1 July onward belongs to the fiscal year ending the following 30 June."
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic shared identifier for the owner's household, the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode. All owners of the same last name and postcode share this value automatically; null when the owner has no postcode.
              type: string
              example: '3F9A2C1D5E8B'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The derived duplicate-detection key, formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId. Two owners collide (409 on create) only when their whole identityKey is equal."
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3F9A2C1D5E8B'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Numeric membership points assigned on creation. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3 for a tenure over one elapsed fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level assigned on creation, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region, taken as the REGION part of the memberId ('<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'); this is the region derived from the postcode (postcode-preferred, city-table fallback: Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane); null when the region is not one of these."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's registration day before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: "True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the capacity limit of 50) before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: "True when, although not a hard duplicate, this owner shares an existing owner's last name and postcode with a different telephone; otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: "The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of, when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; otherwise null."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band derived from birthDate, computed as full years from birthDate to registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied."
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: "The owner's marketing segment '<TIER>_<AREA>': TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'; AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of PREMIUM_METRO, PREMIUM_REGIONAL, STANDARD_METRO, STANDARD_REGIONAL."
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: "True when the owner trips any signup-review heuristic: it is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate is set), its email domain is disposable-adjacent (a known throw-away mail provider under a different TLD, or a domain built from a disposable keyword), or its city is over its soft capacity (capacityWarning is set, i.e. 40 or more owners, approaching the hard cap of 50). Otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: "True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id}; the record is retained and still readable. False for a newly created owner."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object

        content:

        page:

          format: int32

        totalElements:

          format: int64

        totalPages:

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0

    PetPage:

          format: int32

        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32

          example: 2
      required:

        - page

        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object
      properties:

          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string

    Pet:

              example: 1

            ownerId:
              title: Owner ID

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1

              readOnly: true
          required:

            - type
            - visits
    VetFields:

      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: 'James'
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: 'Carter'
        specialties:
          title: Specialties
          description: The specialties of the vet.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Specialty'
      required:
        - firstName

    Vet:

      description: A veterinarian.

        - type: object
          properties:

              minimum: 0

      required:

        - lastName
        - specialties
    VisitFields:

          type: string
          format: date

        description:

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1

    PetTypeFields:
      title: PetType fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet type.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet type.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: cat
      required:
        - name
    PetType:
      title: Pet type
      description: A pet type.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetTypeFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet type.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
    User:
      title: User
      description: An user.
      type: object
      properties:
        username:
          title: username
          description: The username
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: john.doe
        password:
          title: Password
          description: The password
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: 1234abc
        enabled:
          title: enabled
          description: Indicates if the user is enabled
          type: boolean
          example: true
        roles:
          title: Roles
          description: The roles of an user
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Role'
      required:
        - username

      properties:
        name:
          title: name
          description: The role's name
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: admin

        - name

        200:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "The honorific title of the pet owner. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS, DR. When supplied it prefixes the derived 'salutation'."
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' are supplied they are preferred and this field is returned as the composed, normalized address."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: "The first line of the owner's structured postal address. When supplied (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' input; normalized like 'address'."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: "The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. When present it is appended, after a single space, to the normalized 'addressLine1' to form the composed 'address'."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional; when supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares the same last name and postcode (the same household); such a request is created as a declared household member instead of being rejected as a duplicate. Optional; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: "The owner's version-2 identifiers, grouped together. The region code mixed into each carries a fixed 'V2' version tag, so no value matches its version-1 form; the plain region is exposed separately as the top-level 'locality'."
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: "Assigned member ID formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': REGION is the version-2 identity region (the canonical postcode-derived region with the 'V2' tag mixed in); FY is the two-digit fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate; HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone + lastName; and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of <REGION><FY><HASH8>."
          type: string
          example: 'NSWV2261A2B3C4D7'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: "The derived duplicate-detection key: the SHA-256 hex over normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + soundex(lastName) + '|' + the 'V2' version tag. Two owners collide (409 on create) only when their whole identityKey is equal."
          type: string
          example: 'a3f9c1d5e8b2470a1c3e5f7a9b0d2f4e6c8a0b2d4f6e8c0a2b4d6f8e0c2a4b6d'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: "A deterministic shared identifier for the owner's household: the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode + '|' + the 'V2' version tag. All owners of the same last name and postcode share this value automatically; null when the owner has no postcode."
          type: string
          example: '3F9A2C1D5E8B'
          readOnly: true
      readOnly: true
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: "The canonical URI of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>' using the owner's id."
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation formatted as '<title> <lastName>', or just the last name when no title was supplied."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: "The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678')."
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner identity contract this representation follows. Always 2.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: "The owner's version-2 identifiers (memberId, identityKey, householdId), grouped together and no longer at the top level."
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the year the fiscal year ends in. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a date from 1 July onward belongs to the fiscal year ending the following 30 June."
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Numeric membership points assigned on creation. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3 for a tenure over one elapsed fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level assigned on creation, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region, taken as the REGION part of the memberId ('<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'); this is the region derived from the postcode (postcode-preferred, city-table fallback: Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane); null when the region is not one of these."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's registration day before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: "True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the capacity limit of 50) before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: "True when, although not a hard duplicate, this owner shares an existing owner's last name and postcode with a different telephone; otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: "The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of, when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; otherwise null."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band derived from birthDate, computed as full years from birthDate to registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied."
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: "The owner's marketing segment '<TIER>_<AREA>': TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'; AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of PREMIUM_METRO, PREMIUM_REGIONAL, STANDARD_METRO, STANDARD_REGIONAL."
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: "True when the owner trips any signup-review heuristic: it is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate is set), its email domain is disposable-adjacent (a known throw-away mail provider under a different TLD, or a domain built from a disposable keyword), or its city is over its soft capacity (capacityWarning is set, i.e. 40 or more owners, approaching the hard cap of 50). Otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: "True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id}; the record is retained and still readable. False for a newly created owner."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:

All changes are in place and the build is green. Here's a summary of what I implemented for **version 2 of the owner identity**.

## The V2 identity region (mixes in the fixed `V2` tag)
`CityRegion` (`mapper/CityRegion.java`) now defines `IDENTITY_VERSION_TAG = "V2"` plus:
- `identityRegion(postcode, city)` → plain region + `"V2"` (e.g. `NSW` → `NSWV2`), used *inside* identifiers.
- `plainRegion(...)` → strips the tag back to the plain region.

## Every identifier changes, no v1 value reproduced
- **memberId** (`AssignMemberId`): prefix is now the V2 region → `NSWV2261A2B3C4D7`. `MemberId.locality` strips the tag so the recovered region stays plain.
